The '''Dor Nameth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dor Nameth]].
